# DepthMap

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public sealed class DepthMap
```

A per-pixel front/back depth pair for one layer's artwork, so a 2D asset can be lifted into a scene with real parallax. Two bytes per pixel — `front` then `back`, each 0..255 — laid out row-major with the top row first and, within a row, left to right: pixel `(x, y)` lives at byte offset `(y * Width + x) * 2`, front then back. A byte cannot spell more than 255 levels of depth; that is the whole precision this format carries.

### IsFlat { #p-isflat }

```csharp
public bool IsFlat { get; }
```

Whether every byte is zero — a map nobody has painted, front and back both at the surface for every pixel. Computed once when the map is built, never lazily, so it is always consistent with the bytes it describes.

**Parameters**

- `width` (`int`) - Width in pixels; must be positive.
- `height` (`int`) - Height in pixels; must be positive.

**Returns.** A new, all-zero [`DepthMap`](Nfty.Core.Model.DepthMap.md).

### FromBytes(int, int, ReadOnlySpan&lt;byte&gt;) { #m-frombytes-system-int32-system-int32-system-readonlyspa-a448ef }

```csharp
public static DepthMap FromBytes(int width, int height, ReadOnlySpan<byte> bytes);
```

Builds a map from its raw bytes, copying them so the caller cannot mutate the map afterwards.

**Parameters**

- `width` (`int`) - Width in pixels; must be positive.
- `height` (`int`) - Height in pixels; must be positive.
- `bytes` (`ReadOnlySpan<byte>`) - Front/back pairs, row-major, top row first — see the type summary for the exact layout. Must be exactly `width * height * 2` bytes long.

**Returns.** A new [`DepthMap`](Nfty.Core.Model.DepthMap.md) holding a copy of `bytes`.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentException` - `bytes` is not exactly `width * height * 2` bytes long.
